```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(nflreadr)
library(nflplotR)
library(scales)
```



```{r}
# ==========================================
# Load Data and Retrieve Player Headshots
# ==========================================

decel_df <- read_csv(
  "../Analysis/31_WR_Decel_Comparison_Table.csv"
) %>%
  head(5)

rosters <- nflreadr::load_rosters(seasons = 2023:2025) %>%
  select(gsis_id, full_name) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gsis_id)) %>%
  distinct(full_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

decel_df <- decel_df %>%
  mutate(
    display_name = recode(
      display_name,
      "Antwane Wells" = "Antwane Wells Jr."
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(rosters, by = c("display_name" = "full_name")) %>%
  arrange(desc(decel_score))

# Check which players successfully matched to an NFL roster ID
print(
  decel_df %>%
    select(display_name, decel_score, gsis_id)
)

# Replace missing IDs with blank strings instead of displaying "NA"
decel_df <- decel_df %>%
  mutate(
    gsis_id = if_else(is.na(gsis_id), "", gsis_id)
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. Define color scales for the table
# ============================================================

# Deceleration score: darker green indicates a higher score
score_palette <- scales::col_numeric(
  palette = c("#FFFFFF", "#006D2C"),
  domain = c(80, 90)
)

# Draft pick: earlier picks receive darker green shading
draft_palette <- scales::col_numeric(
  palette = c("#006D2C", "#FFFFFF"),
  domain = c(1, 257)
)

# Rank difference: red indicates a negative difference,
# yellow indicates approximately zero, and green indicates
# a positive difference
rank_max <- max(abs(decel_df$`Rank Difference`), na.rm = TRUE)

if (!is.finite(rank_max) || rank_max == 0) {
  rank_max <- 1
}

rank_palette <- scales::col_numeric(
  palette = c("#D73027", "#FFFFBF", "#1A9850"),
  domain = c(-rank_max, rank_max)
)


# ============================================================
# 4. Create the table
# ============================================================

decel_table <- decel_df %>%
  select(
    display_name,
    gsis_id,
    decel_score,
    draft_overall_pick,
    ngs_athleticism_score,
    `Rank Difference`
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%

  # Set column header labels; leave the headshot column blank
  cols_label(
    display_name = "PLAYER",
    gsis_id = "",
    decel_score = "DECELERATION SCORE",
    draft_overall_pick = "DRAFT PICK",
    ngs_athleticism_score = "NGS ATHLETICISM SCORE",
    `Rank Difference` = "RANK DIFFERENCE"
  ) %>%

  # Add NFL player headshots
  nflplotR::gt_nfl_headshots(
    columns = gsis_id,
    height = 75
  ) %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Format and color the deceleration score
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  fmt_number(
    columns = decel_score,
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = decel_score,
    fn = score_palette
  ) %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Format and color the draft pick
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  fmt(
    columns = draft_overall_pick,
    fns = function(x) {
      ifelse(is.na(x), "—", as.character(x))
    }
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = draft_overall_pick,
    fn = function(x) {
      pick <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
      colors <- rep("#FFFFFF", length(x))

      valid <- !is.na(pick) & pick >= 1 & pick <= 257

      colors[valid] <- draft_palette(pick[valid])
      colors[is.na(x)] <- "#D3D3D3"

      colors
    }
  ) %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Format and color the NGS athleticism score
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  fmt_number(
    columns = ngs_athleticism_score,
    decimals = 1
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = ngs_athleticism_score,
    fn = scales::col_numeric(
      palette = c("#FFFFFF", "#006D2C"),
      domain = c(50, 100)
    )
  ) %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Format and color the rank difference
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  fmt_number(
    columns = `Rank Difference`,
    decimals = 0,
    force_sign = TRUE
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = `Rank Difference`,
    fn = rank_palette
  ) %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Add the table title and set column widths
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  tab_header(
    title = md("**TOP 5 DECELERATION PROSPECTS**")
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    display_name ~ px(200),
    gsis_id ~ px(110),
    decel_score ~ px(145),
    draft_overall_pick ~ px(135),
    ngs_athleticism_score ~ px(175),
    `Rank Difference` ~ px(165)
  ) %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # General table styling: font, sizing, spacing, and borders
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  tab_options(
    table.font.names = "Arial",
    table.font.size = px(19),
    heading.title.font.size = px(29),
    heading.align = "left",
    table.border.top.width = px(3),
    table.border.bottom.width = px(3),
    column_labels.background.color = "white",
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    column_labels.font.size = px(15),
    data_row.padding = px(15),
    table_body.hlines.color = "#E5E5E5",
    table_body.vlines.color = "#FFFFFF",
    table.width = pct(100),
    table.background.color = "white"
  ) %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Style column headers
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(
      color = "#1B263B",
      weight = "bold",
      size = px(15)
    ),
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "center"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = -display_name)
  ) %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Align and format table body text
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(
      align = "center",
      size = px(24),
      color = "black"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(columns = -display_name)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(
      align = "left",
      size = px(22),
      weight = "bold",
      style = "italic",
      color = "black"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(columns = display_name)
  ) %>%

  # Add alternating row shading and an outside border
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  opt_table_outline(
    style = "solid",
    color = "#D9D9D9",
    width = px(1)
  ) %>%
    # Footnote explaining the rank difference
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = paste(
      "Rank Difference = NGS Athleticism Rank - Deceleration Rank.",
      "Positive values indicate the deceleration metric ranks a player",
      "higher than NGS; negative values indicate a lower ranking."
    ),
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = `Rank Difference`)
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. Display and save the table
# ============================================================

decel_table

# ==========================================
# Export for PowerPoint
# ==========================================

gtsave(
  data = decel_table,
  filename = "decel_top5.png",
  zoom = 2
)
```
